207:t_018:0.en:
$$かなめ$$
「...I'll... be all right, so you...」

207:t_018:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'll... bring you back... no matter what...」

207:t_018:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「Let's go, $$千鳥かなめ$$. To our place.」

207:t_020:2.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「I confirm a distortion in the dimensional boundary...! A $$時空震動$$ will occur if this continues!」

207:t_020:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That man... is going to cause a $$時空震動$$!」

207:t_020:4.en:
$$いぶき$$
「Then those $$ヘテロダイン$$s earlier...!」

207:t_020:6.en:
$$レナード$$
「I made use of them as a by-product of my research.」

207:t_020:7.en:
$$シャア$$
(The $$ウィスパード$$...! So they really are the multiverse's...)

207:t_020:8.en:
$$レナード$$
「This $$時空震動弾$$ is only a prototype. But it should be able to transport this whole area.」

207:t_021:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「He intends to transport this whole area!」

207:t_021:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But if we do, the town...!」

207:t_022:2.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Captain! A machine is rapidly approaching this area!」

207:t_024:2.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Captain! A machine is rapidly approaching this area!」

207:t_025:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「The $$クロノ$$ Reformists' $$アスクレプス$$...!」

207:t_027:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「What's going on?! Our attacks are barely causing any damage!」

207:t_027:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「It's an application of the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$. Though this $$ベリアル$$ is about the only machine capable of it.」

207:t_027:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「But that doesn't make it invincible! If we keep attacking, eventually...!」

207:t_027:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「Don't you understand it's useless...? Or don't you want to admit it...?」

207:t_027:4.en:
$$レナード$$
「Either way, you're a troublesome opponent.」

207:t_100:0.en:
$n
「This is different from $$アマルガム$$'s previous attacks...! So they're serious this time!」

207:t_100:2.en:
$n
「Let's concentrate on protecting the school and town right now, Miss $$スズネ$$!」

207:t_100:3.en:
$n
($$宗介$$... I'm counting on you to protect $$千鳥$$...!)

207:t_101:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「Damn! The third term ends tomorrow, and they attack now?!」

207:t_101:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'll never let them do it! We're students at $$陣代高校$$ too!」

207:t_102:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「How dare you lay a hand on our $$第２新東京市$$!」

207:t_102:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「Wait for us, everyone at $$陣代高校$$! We'll protect the town and school, no matter what!」

207:t_103:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$恭子$$, $$詩織$$, everyone...! I'll never let them touch $$陣代高校$$!」

207:t_103:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「This Japan still had peace! I'll crush every last one who threatens it!!」

207:t_104:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「$$陣代高校$$ is another alma mater for us!」

207:t_104:1.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I'll protect it! As a student of Class 2-4 and a member of the $$ボランティア部$$!」

207:t_105:0.en:
$$宗介$$
(My combat experience and instincts tell me...)

207:t_105:1.en:
$$宗介$$
(that I have no cards in hand that will work against this enemy... and that resisting is pointless...)

207:t_105:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「You don't know when to give up. Then I'll show her your corpse.」

207:t_105:4.en:
$$レナード$$
「That will break her will to resist too. And it will all be over.」

207:t_105:6.en:
$$レナード$$
「It's useless. You already know that yourself.」
